newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Inkombank U.S. ADR roadshow June 4-6.
newsitem.headline: Inkombank U.S. ADR roadshow June 4-6.

text.p: Inkombank, one of Russia's ten largest commercial banks, said it will have an investor roadshow for its level-one American Depositary Receipts in New York and Boston on June 4-6.
Inkombank ADRs are already trading in Germany and the U.S.

Brokerage C.A. Atlantic Securities Inc clinched the first two deals for 5,500 Inkombank ADRs at $12.25 per ADR in January this year. So far about 400,000 Inkombank ADRs, each of which covers 15 underlying shares, have been sold.

Inkombank was the first Russian bank to issue the receipts, which allow foreign trade in the shares. Under its ADR programme, Inkombank can issue up to three percent of charter capital, or nine million ordinary shares, to foreign investors.
No more than 600,000 Inkombank ADRs will be issued on the U.S. over-the-counter market.
The Bank of New York is acting as the depositary bank, ING-Bank Euroasia (Moscow) is the custodian for the deposited share, while Inkombank is acting as its own broker.
Inkombank plans to issue level-two and level-three ADRs in 1997 and 1998 but has not given details about the issue volume.
Russian bank Vozrozhdeniye sold three percent of its charter capital through ADRs in March to CS First Boston.
